scripts.build: astro build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('dist/_routes.json','utf8'));j.exclude=j.exclude.filter(e=>!e.startsWith('/blog/')&&!e.startsWith('/chronicle/'));fs.writeFileSync('dist/_routes.json',JSON.stringify(j,null,1));console.log('Patched _routes.json: blog/chronicle routes included in Worker');"
